content: GitHub recommends validating the webhook HMAC signature before processing, storing the secret securely, using HTTPS, subscribing only to needed events, acknowledging within 10 seconds, queuing longer work, deduplicating by X-GitHub-Delivery (which remains the same on redelivery), and tolerating out-of-order events. Sources: https://docs.github.com/en/webhooks/using-webhooks/validating-webhook-deliveries and https://docs.github.com/en/webhooks/using-webhooks/best-practices-for-using-webhooks
